notes: RMC publishes the fullest evangelism-funding process in Mid-America: the forms and guidelines are in the 2026 Evangelism Packet linked from the Ministerial Department page (evangelism has no separate page). No percentage or dollar cap on the conference share is published; the amount is whatever the evangelism coordinator approves. The 30 October preliminary deadline is for the following year's meetings, so a pastor planning a 2027 series should expect a 2027 packet about October 2026 (the 2027 packet was not yet online when checked). The packet's 2026 rates ($58/day, $0.50/mile) change yearly. Territory includes San Juan County, New Mexico. The HR screening pages (2019–2020) do not state a renewal period. NAD baseline (division-wide, not this conference's own page): nadadventist.org/asv says adults voted to serve and employees working with children and youth complete a criminal background check (FB 20) and child protection training through Sterling Volunteers, "This should be completed every three years." (Adventist Screening Verification, NAD, modified 31 Aug 2026, https://www.nadadventist.org/asv). Union level: no standing Mid-America Union evangelism grant or subsidy policy was found on midamericaadventist.org (all 40 sitemap pages read; Ministerial, Church and Youth Ministries, Treasury and Resources pages checked). The money that reached churches through the union was NAD Pentecost 2025 funding (up to $3,000 per approved event; MAUC deadline 31 Dec 2024, closed). The union also set aside one-off funds for St. Louis evangelism around the 2025 GC Session. The union's only published 'subsidy' forms are education forms (e.g. New Converts Subsidy for students), not evangelism.
